# Elysia9X documentation

> A production engineering standard for Bun and TypeScript applications. This index links to Markdown source pages suitable for retrieval-augmented generation and coding-agent context.

Start with the introduction and architecture reference. Prefer focused pages over loading the full corpus.

- Full reference: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms-full.txt

## Coding-agent integrations

Elysia9X separates deterministic governance from LLM reasoning.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/agents.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/agents

## Reference system architecture

Elysia9X combines Vertical Slice Architecture, Domain-Driven Design where useful, Hexagonal Architecture, a frontend-oriented BFF, selective CQRS, policy-as-code and transactional outbox patterns.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/architecture.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/architecture

## Authorization and permission governance

Authorization is a mandatory subsystem. Authentication establishes a verified principal; authorization decides whether that principal can perform an action on a resource in a context.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/authorization.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/authorization

## `@elysia9x/cli`

The CLI is a Bun-native, dependency-light governance tool. It is read-only by default except for explicit initialization and integration installation commands.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/cli.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/cli

## Context7, `llms.txt` and documentation discovery

Elysia9X is prepared for Context7 indexing, but indexing requires a public repository or public documentation URL to be submitted to Context7.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/context7.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/context7

## Data ownership, transactions and migrations

PostgreSQL is the default transactional source of truth. Drizzle is an infrastructure adapter. Feature modules own schema definitions; a central schema aggregator feeds a centrally ordered migration history.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/data.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/data

## Deployment topologies

Use Traefik for TLS termination, host/path routing, redirects, edge rate limits, request size controls, health-aware routing and privacy-safe access logs. It is not the application's permission engine.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/deployment.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/deployment

## Feature modules and ownership

A feature owns its domain model, use cases, persistence adapters, transport routes, UI components and tests. Its `index.ts` is the public entry point.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/features.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/features

## What is Elysia9X?

Elysia9X is an independent engineering standard and toolchain for building production TypeScript applications, especially applications using Bun, React, Next.js and Elysia.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/introduction.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/introduction

## Developing agent plugins

Agent integrations live under `packages/plugins/<agent>/` and are independent workspace packages.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/plugin-development.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/plugin-development

## Engineering principles

Prefer `features/missions/` over global `controllers/`, `models/` and `views/` directories. The code that changes together should be easy to find together.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/principles.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/principles

## Testing, observability and operational readiness

Authorization tests must include negative cases, cross-tenant attempts and object-level boundaries.

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/guide/quality-operations.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/guide/quality-operations

## Elysia9X

**A production engineering standard for Bun, TypeScript and AI-assisted software delivery.**

- Markdown: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/llms/pages/index.md
- Website: https://0xws.github.io/e9x/
